Achievements

Every current goal, its exact requirement and its trophy reward. Hidden discoveries stay folded until you choose to reveal them.

Getting started

  • FIRST TURN

    Finish any valid lap.

    25trophies

  • TAKE IT FROM THE TOP

    Use Restart Lap after the current lap becomes void.

    25trophies

  • CHARGE THROUGH IT

    Recharge at least 25% of the Boost meter while drifting in one lap.

    25trophies

  • SECOND WIND

    Run Boost empty, let it recharge, then activate Boost again.

    25trophies

  • FLOW STATE

    Finish a valid lap using only Drift and Boost for forward drive.

    Recommended: Learner Car · Countryside

    50trophies

  • WATCH AND LEARN

    Spectate a rival for five seconds, then return to the start.

    25trophies

  • YOUR OWN RIVAL

    Finish a valid lap with one of your saved rivals on the track.

    25trophies

  • LEVEL HEAD

    Recalibrate, then finish a valid lap.

    25trophies

  • NEW WHEELS

    Finish a valid lap with a vehicle other than the Learner Car.

    25trophies

  • NEW GROUND

    Finish valid laps on two different tracks.

    25trophies

  • GOT STARTED

    Finish all Getting Started achievements.

    75trophies

Ways to play

  • TURN TUTORIAL

    Finish TURN TUTORIAL: one lap of COUNTRYSIDE in the LEARNER CAR.

    25trophies

  • LEARN TO PLAY

    Read all five parts of QUICK REFERENCE in HOW TO PLAY.

    50trophies

  • DRIVE BY EAR

    Finish all five parts of DRIVE BY EAR TUTORIAL.

    50trophies

  • TRUST YOUR EARS

    Finish a valid lap with Blank screen mode on from start to finish.

    200trophies

  • LISTEN CLOSELY

    Set Sound balance to at least 75% Drive By Ear, then drive for ten seconds with Blank screen mode on.

    Recommended for non-visual driving: 90% Drive By Ear

    100trophies

  • BEYOND SIGHT

    Finish a valid lap on every track with Blank screen mode on from start to finish.

    300trophies

Scoring

  • CATCH THE CHARGE

    With BOOST full, keep using DRIFT to build purple OVERCHARGE. Slide to GAS to catch it before it leaks away.

    25trophies

  • HEAD START

    Finish a valid lap with OVERCHARGE, then use that carried OVERCHARGE with BOOST to beat it on the next lap.

    Build OVERCHARGE before the line, catch it with GAS, then BOOST after crossing for a flying start.

    50trophies
